principle: Replicators transform logistics and scarcity but do not erase energy, feedstock, access, legality, specialized fabrication, rare materials, time, location or political constraints.
rules: Do not model Federation society as a universal moneyless rule for every civilization.
A replicator cannot fabricate unsupported/forbidden matter or equipment merely because the player asks.
Power loss, damage, access rules and pattern availability affect use.
A replicated common item does not imply that every industrial or strategic component is locally producible.
Scarcity may remain social, legal, spatial, informational, energetic, material or capacity-based.
